name: Podcastfy
description: Turns web pages, PDFs and other multimodal content into multilingual conversational audio, like NotebookLM's podcast feature.
whatItDoes: Generates a two-speaker podcast episode from URLs, documents and other inputs. It is for creators and developers who want programmable audio summaries.
howItWorks: Content is extracted from the inputs, an LLM writes a conversational transcript, and a text-to-speech service voices it. It is available as a Python package and a command-line client and requires ffmpeg for audio processing.

requirements.name: LLM and TTS provider keys
requirements.description: Keys for the chosen transcript model and speech service
